context_for_next_testing_agent: Material Library feature fully tested and working. Key endpoints: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/library/materials, POST /api/library/materials/{id}/assign, POST /api/library/materials/{id}/unassign. Frontend page at /library with data-testid='material-library'. Upload button: data-testid='upload-library-btn'. Sidebar link: data-testid='library-link'. Fixed frontend bug where upload was sending form data instead of query params for non-file fields.
rca_of_the_issue: Frontend upload bug: MaterialLibrary.js was appending non-file fields (title, description, week_number, material_type) to FormData, but the backend FastAPI endpoint expects these as query parameters. Fixed by using URLSearchParams to append parameters to the URL instead of FormData.
